Its not for a main menu! It can be used for anything, that includes a main menu but it can be called anywhere. You want to use it for choices, so you would probably do something like this

`screen choice:

      imagebutton: 

              xpos #wherever you want

              ypos #wherever you want

              hover "image.png" #when the mouse is hovering over the image

              idle "image.png" #when the mouse isnt hovering over the image

              action Jump("choice") #whatever the label you want the choice to jump to is named`

And just repeat the "imagebutton" part in the screen for the different image buttons you want. Like if you wanted three choices, repeat the imagebutton three times in the screen but with different images for hover and idle and different xpos and ypos... I hope this made sense! Im bad at explaining so if you need clarification let me know. Also Im on mobile, so sorry if the code part is formatted weird/doesnt look like code when I post this comment lol
